# J121: three exact own222 nonwinners, not own110

This complete literal input capsule recovers three NEW homogeneous H-polyhedra. Each has exactly strict (S,U,H)=(2,2,2), additional weak000, primitive zero000, one positive P and one positive Q bar. These are not a new canonical own110 record. Their producing search was numerical; the stated endpoint classifications and all positive bars were subsequently computed by exact115.cpp with assertions enabled.

Required exact source dependency: [internal-source-reference], J115_EXACT_AUDITOR_SOURCE.md. Its actual wrapper SHA is ac3226f5ae6212be2bedfa4f5797dbd7fa9f4d0f1e3969c3753825a98b9ba4fc. Extract complete exact115.cpp, 11038 bytes, SHA d7fd1244c086a0c5354844cca3453c42b26ed31a55b89720aa9e3987f0a06736. This capsule plus that exact source is sufficient without a sandbox or a numerical optimizer. Compile: g++ -std=c++17 -O2 exact115.cpp -lgmpxx -lgmp -o exact115. Then run ./exact115 < NAME.txt > NAME.audit.json 2> NAME.audit.log. Do not define NDEBUG.

All listed depth intervals are open (a,a+1)/10^15. PAIRED_Q_QP_G8: V88/E132/F46,C264, P a=249294542946628, Q a=207649835210521, S=[0,31], U=[23,71], H=[[82,85],[1,59]]. PAIRED_RELAYP_G8: V96/E144/F50,C288, P a=247677223390840, Q a=206303987349428, S=[6,36], U=[11,53], H=[[17,55],[77,81]]. PAIRED_RELAYQ_G8: V90/E135/F47,C270, P a=245357468575877, Q a=204368769327801, S=[0,31], U=[4,62], H=[[54,81],[7,45]]. Labels are this exact auditor's current ordering, not floating search indices. Full exact own centroid, volume, maximal facets, true edges, every positive bar and direct/global census reconstruct in the JSON outputs.

The source uses two internal mass formulas and direct/global predicates. These are the coordinator's executions of one existing exact engine, not two independent physics verifications. Both original defects remain.
